## Summary

Describe the scientific or engineering change in 2–4 sentences.

## Why this change?

- [ ] Architecture / implementation
- [ ] Paper Skill schema or evidence extraction
- [ ] Evidence graph / relation logic
- [ ] Benchmark / evaluation
- [ ] Safety / provenance
- [ ] Documentation

## Validation

- [ ] `pytest -q` passes
- [ ] No benchmark or clinical-performance claims were added without evidence
- [ ] New evidence claims include provenance
- [ ] Safety-sensitive behavior was reviewed when relevant

## Notes for reviewers

List assumptions, known limitations, and any follow-up work.
